title: Design System: The Living Engineering Notebook

display.purpose: Pinned WHAT IF? desktop headline: clamp(140px, 16vw, 240px), 68% font-stretch; compact desktop uses clamp(140px, 17vw, 190px). Intentionally exceeds 96px. CSS functions are omitted from portable frontmatter dimensions, not replaced with fixed sizes.

display-mobile.purpose: Hero at 700px and below: clamp(110px, 29vw, 190px), 72% font-stretch; remains intentionally oversized.

headline.purpose: Heavy section headings: clamp(34px, 4vw, 60px), 85% font-stretch; approach and about retain documented local sizes.

title.purpose: Project headings, 26px on mobile; no category eyebrow.

body-compact.purpose: Project descriptions, section copy, and native summaries.

body-large.purpose: 40ch approach prose, reduced to 18px on mobile.

navigation.purpose: All four native anchors, including on mobile.

link.purpose: Underlined semibold anchors with inline SVG arrows and 44px minimum height.

caption.purpose: Renderer/disclaimer caption lines, project-art disclosure, informational placeholder label, and Reset button; drawing caption lead-in is 13px.

control-label.purpose: Native joint labels and actual angle outputs; outputs are amber, use tabular numerals, and have aria-live off.

control-status.purpose: Compact role=status feedback, including explicit closest-reachable-pose explanation when a target is limited.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Anchor/button color, background-color, and border-color feedback; no autonomous object or background movement.

motion.name: link-arrow
motion.purpose: Up-right text-link arrow shifts 2px right and 2px up on hover.

motion.name: disclosure-indicator
motion.purpose: Native details plus stroke rotates from 90deg to 0deg when opened.

motion.name: anchor-scroll
motion.purpose: Native document anchor scrolling; reduced motion switches to auto.

motion.name: joint-damping
motion.purpose: Input-driven joint-angle interpolation only; forward kinematics recomputes rigid endpoints. Direct sliders snap. Frames stop when settled, offscreen, or tab-hidden; there is no continuous idle loop.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Snap every requested pose, zero CSS transition/animation durations, and disable smooth scrolling. No autonomous movement or pause control.

narrative.overview:
One continuous charcoal drawing surface: chalk-white questions, heavy condensed lettering, and a material linkage integrated with construction geometry. Manrope keeps the engineering notes approachable. The interface recedes so the drawing and the owner's interdisciplinary practice carry the character; amber marks joints, small emphasis, and usable states rather than a second theme.

This merges the approved Phase 1–2 foundation with the explicitly authorized Phase 3 interactive Three.js linkage, the confirmed public name Francesco Trotti, and brighter dots. The notebook ground and typography extend through the preserved portfolio sections. Phase 4 section recomposition and Phase 5 background/scroll choreography remain deferred; this is not a completed six-phase redesign. Only requested mechanism movement animates; the drawing sheet remains static.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral charcoal with a continuous, registered white dotted field.
Oversized Archivo Variable questions paired with readable Manrope notes.
Original SVG mechanics progressively enhanced with registered Three.js geometry and real fixed-link kinematics.
Native angle controls with interactive SVG fallback; reading, anchors, and disclosures work without JavaScript.

rules.name: The Continuous Sheet Rule
rules.body: Keep the document's dotted ground continuous through transparent section grounds; do not restore the former blue bench or brass venture panel.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use heavy, width-variable Archivo for expressive headings and Manrope for reading, captions, navigation, and actions; do not restore the former display face.

dos: **Do** preserve neutral charcoal, registered dots, transparent section grounds, and square interface geometry.
**Do** retain the intentionally oversized question and the Archivo/Manrope division of roles.
**Do** keep illustration captions, factual placeholders, native navigation/disclosures, visible focus, and reduced-motion handling.
**Do** preserve all four navigation anchors and trailing project discipline metadata on mobile.
**Do** keep joint controls truthful, link lengths rigid, the complete silhouette within one shared field, and SVG usable when 3D fails.
**Do** stop at authorized Phase 3; keep Phase 4 section recomposition and Phase 5 background/scroll choreography deferred.
donts: **Don't** restore obsolete blue accents, former fonts, brass panels, or actuator bench controls from the superseded system.
**Don't** animate the dotted field, add autonomous mechanism motion, or claim a completed six-phase redesign.
**Don't** invent projects, results, identity, measurements, telemetry, startup traction, delivered impact, or contact destinations.
**Don't** make reading, navigation, or project disclosures depend on JavaScript or WebGL.
**Don't** turn explanatory notes into reusable decorative eyebrows or treat review screenshots as shipped imagery.
